cells.reason: Raymond James reports its fee-based and advisory revenue on client assets as 'asset management and related administrative fees,' providing both quarterly dollar figures and average client fee rates on assets under management.

items.text: Raymond James states it earns asset management and related administrative fees in the Private Client Group segment for performing asset management, portfolio management, and related investment services for retail clients for assets invested in fee-based accounts.
items.quote: We earn asset management and related administrative fees in this segment for performing asset management, portfolio management, and related investment services for retail clients for assets invested in fee-based accounts.
items.definition: fees for performing asset management, portfolio management, and related investment services for retail clients for assets invested in fee-based accounts

items.text: Raymond James states the vast majority of the revenues it earns from fee-based accounts are recorded in 'Asset management and related administrative fees,' and that fees received from such accounts are based on the value of client assets in fee-based accounts.
items.quote: The vast majority of the revenues we earn from fee-based accounts are recorded in "Asset management and related administrative fees" on our Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income and Comprehensive Income. Fees received from such accounts are based on the value of client assets in fee-based accounts
items.definition: fees based on the value of client assets in fee-based accounts

items.text: Raymond James reported consolidated asset management and related administrative fees of $1.88 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30, 2025, up 13% over the prior year.
items.quote: Asset management and related administrative fees of $1.88 billion grew 13% over the prior year and 8% over the preceding quarter.

items.text: Raymond James reported Private Client Group asset management and related administrative fees of $1.69 billion for the fiscal first quarter ended December 31, 2025, up 15% from the prior-year quarter.
items.quote: Asset management and related administrative fees increased 15% from last year's first quarter to $1.69 billion, mainly due to market appreciation and net inflows into PCG fee-based accounts.

items.text: Raymond James reported Private Client Group asset management and related administrative fees of $1.71 billion for the fiscal second quarter ended March 31, 2026, up 17% from the prior-year quarter.
items.quote: asset management and related administrative fees which grew 17% to $1.71 billion, mainly due to market appreciation and net inflows into PCG fee-based accounts.

items.text: Raymond James reported Private Client Group asset management and related administrative fees of $1.73 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026, up 19% from the prior-year quarter.
items.quote: asset management and related administrative fees, which grew 19% to $1.73 billion mainly due to market appreciation and net inflows into PCG fee-based accounts.
